$comment: Licenses Treepeek may ship without review (SPDX ids), and reviewed exceptions. An exception names one package, grammar or theme, the license the review found ("license"), the value the package or collection records when that differs ("recorded"; the exception stops applying when the record changes), and why it is acceptable: {"package" | "grammar" | "theme": name, "license": id, "recorded"?: value, "reason": text}. A grammar or theme exception also needs the license text read upstream in build/asset-licenses/<kind>-<name>.txt. Checked by `bun run licenses:check`.

exceptions.reason: MPL-2.0: LICENSE, and the README states that the syntax files are MPL-2.0 (only the samples, not bundled, are MIT) at bird-chinese-community/BIRD-tm-language-grammar@42fec06a. MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft: the grammar is shipped as Shiki converts it, the full MPL-2.0 text is in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES, and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES names its source file, grammars/bird2.tmLanguage.json, at that commit.
